title: Telstra outage: The night a network decided the year was 2006
summary: This article analyzes a major Telstra network outage caused by an NTP time synchronization failure where network systems incorrectly believed it was 2006, triggering cascading failures in DNS and other time-dependent services across Australia's telecommunications infrastructure.
problem_solved: Provides incident analysis and lessons learned from a critical telecommunications outage caused by time synchronization errors.
why_valuable: Offers real-world post-mortem insights for network engineers on how seemingly minor time synchronization issues can cascade into massive infrastructure failures.
